description: This file contains CSS styles for a web application's UI theme, including variables for themes (light and dark), styling for layout components such as sidebar, topbar, buttons, cards, tables, and other UI primitives. It defines themes, responsive behaviors, and visual styles for various interface elements, emphasizing a consistent elegant theme with rose gold, warm gold, and lilac accents. The file also includes styles for skeleton loading states, badges, profile dropdowns, and responsive design adjustments.
